# jsbeeb controller test sources

Unmodified files from mattgodbolt/jsbeeb revision
`d74d9043e83b981a4a3fe1d621f309e8bf083a9c`:

- [test-intel-fdc.js](https://github.com/mattgodbolt/jsbeeb/blob/d74d9043e83b981a4a3fe1d621f309e8bf083a9c/tests/unit/test-intel-fdc.js)
- [test-wd-fdc.js](https://github.com/mattgodbolt/jsbeeb/blob/d74d9043e83b981a4a3fe1d621f309e8bf083a9c/tests/unit/test-wd-fdc.js)
- Original GPL-3.0 LICENSE, retained alongside the source.

Attribution: jsbeeb contributors. Adapted assertions in 8271_TESTS and
1770_TESTS retain the upstream expectations. These unit tests have no attached
per-case real-BBC capture or hardware-result claim. Their local adaptations
are therefore **Unverified**, not hardware conformance evidence.

The full original pair of test files passed 41/41 cases on 15 September 2026.
See each project's PROVENANCE.md for selected case mappings, fixture differences
and reproduction commands. SHA-256 values are in ../sources.json.
